svg.aria-label: Detection pipeline: the Cisco network, OPNsense and Suricata, the Windows domain, Proxmox and Docker, and UniFi send logs to Wazuh, which decodes, correlates and responds, then forwards events to Splunk for search and dashboards. A brute force on DC-01 is caught, raises a level 10 alert and the source is blocked by active response.
svg.title: Detection pipeline
